title: Change lifecycle sentry with cost-adaptive stabilization and safe reversion
creator: Anika Rao
description: Introduce a Change Lifecycle Sentry: an automated policy layer that recommends batching/caching config changes, simulates impact in shadow, applies safe staged changes, and automatically stabilizes or reverts based on cost and reliability envelopes.
background: We frequently ship config adjustments that tune batching, cache TTLs, and quantization profiles to reduce per-token costs. A small percentage of changes cause throughput regressions, tail-latency spikes, or functional regressions in downstream apps. Current manual rollback is slow; existing automated revert systems surface noisy triggers or revert prematurely. We need a combined recommendation + safe-apply + reconciliation flow that understands cost trade-offs and application signals before reverting.
proposal: Build a Change Lifecycle Sentry service that runs three coordinated stages: 1) Recommendation & Simulation: produce suggested batching/cache parameter deltas using workload-aware heuristics and run a shadow simulation against a sampled traffic replay. 2) Staged Apply with Guardrails: apply changes using a probation window (config cohorts, progressive traffic ramp), continuous sanity checks, and an adaptive cost/reliability envelope that tolerates small cost regressions if reliability improves. 3) Safe Reversion & State Reconciliation: if ensemble signals cross thresholds, perform a controlled rollback with state reconciliation using atomic config snapshots and idempotent apply paths. The system will rank signals and compute a single 'stability score' to adjudicate automatic rollback vs hold and alert.
tradeoffs_and_decisions:
- Conservative vs aggressive: default to conservative probation windows for production routes, allow opt-in aggressive mode for low-risk workloads.
- Signal weighting: prioritize user-visible errors and tail-latency over small cost fluctuations.
- Simulation fidelity: replay sampling has limitations; we'll bias safety by requiring at least two independent signals (service error increase + cost delta outside expected band) before auto-revert.
- Complexity vs reliability: keep reconciliation deterministic (checksum-based snapshots, monotonic version tags) to simplify failure modes.
acceptance_criteria:
- Sentry produces a recommended batching/cache delta and a simulation report for 95% of candidate changes.
- Staged apply framework can ramp config to 50% traffic with rollback capability within 60s.
- Automatic revert triggers only when stability score <= 0.35 and at least two independent signals cross thresholds.
- No false-autoreverts for <1% of releases during 30-day dogfood.
- Playbook and dashboards exist for on-call to inspect recommendation, sim report, and reconcile failure cases.
rollout_plan:
1) Canary in staging: deploy to infra-staging with sample replay harness. 2) Dogfood on non-critical customer-facing routes (low-RPS) with conservative probation settings. 3) Expand to internal SRE flows and benches for 2 weeks. 4) Gradual production rollout: 5% traffic -> 20% -> 50% with automated gating. 5) Full opt-in for teams after 30d.
Rollback steps: restore snapshot, increment config version, purge prefix-specific KV snapshots if incompatible, run reconciliation job to ensure runtime state matches control-plane config.
test_plan:
- Unit tests for recommendation heuristics and stability score math.
- Integration tests: shadow simulation against recorded traces from last 7 days.
- Chaos tests: inject 10% latency/packet-loss and validate sentinel prevents escalated rollout.
- Regression tests: ensure no regressions in immediate latency and 99.9th percentile CPU for serving nodes.
- Smoke: automated canary rollouts with one-click manual revert for SRE.
metrics_and_alerts:
Primary metrics: per-route token cost delta, end-to-end p99 latency, request error rate (4xx/5xx), KV cache hit rate, batch size distribution, stability score.
Alerts: immediate paging if stability score < 0.2 OR (p99 latency + error rate) increase beyond configured SLO band.
Dashboards: Recommendation outcomes, simulation vs observed delta, recent rollbacks, reconciliation failures.
risks_and_mitigation:
- Risk: noisy signals cause churn. Mitigation: require multi-signal consensus and hysteresis windows.
- Risk: state mismatch after rollback (e.g., KV cache promoted). Mitigation: snapshot and checkpoint KV prefixes before apply; reconciliation job rehydrates or trims inconsistent keys.
- Risk: simulation blindspots. Mitigation: conservative default and human-in-loop review for high-risk models.
